title: Segment Plan
description: Script segmentation plan produced by the Segment Director. Splits narration into ordered scenes with search queries, visual descriptions, pacing types, and mood tags.

narration.description: Full narration text for this scene

duration_seconds.description: Target duration based on narration word count

pacing.description: Pacing type that drives cut timing and hold duration

search_queries.description: Tiered search queries ordered from most specific to most general

visual_description.description: Rich prose description of the ideal footage for this scene

mood.description: Emotional mood tag for music and tone matching

rhythm.description: Scene Library: shot-duration nuance over the pacing type ('breath' = held beat after a peak).

narration_mode.description: Scene Library: narration↔visual relationship (literal/evocative/none). Best work alternates.

audio_transition.description: Scene Library: audio-aware handoff to the next scene (j_cut leads / l_cut trails / sound_bridge glues).

retention_beat.description: Scene Library: episode-structure role (cold open / pattern interrupt / re-hook / cliffhanger / payoff).
